fields.Field Name (EN): Beneficiary document type and identification number
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Tipo de documento y numero de identificacion del beneficiario
fields.Format: N (code) + AN (number)
fields.Field Explanation: COMPOSITE FIELD as drafted in the resolution - numeral 2 names BOTH the document type and the number in a single numeral, and the technical specification splits them into two columns. Sub-field 1 = the DIAN identity-document type code from the 'Tipo de documento (numerals 2 and 34)' table on the Field Options sheet; sub-field 2 = the identification number without dots or hyphens, kept as text so leading zeros survive. SOURCE AT PMI: the client master data has no type-code field - it stores the number in one column per document type (Citizenship Card ID, Indentity Card for Foreigners, Identity Card, National ID). The engine must hold an explicit Employee.Document_Type, derived once from the populated column through a client-confirmed mapping, with a priority rule where more than one column is filled (14 of 261 master-data rows). POPULATION: the record is required for EVERY person paid in the tax year, including leavers and employer-paid pensioners who are not in the current master-data snapshot - their document type and number must be retained after termination. At PMI 8 persons paid in the year and absent from the master data have no identification number in any mapped report; their identity must be sourced before build. Where a payment is made to a payee other than the employee (the client's accumulators carry a separate 'Beneficiary National Id', mostly on pension payments), the identity reported is that of the beneficiary of the payment - to be confirmed with RA. PERSISTENCE: this pair is the join key across every Colombian artefact for the employee - electronic payroll NIE044 / NIE045, PILA Record Tipo 2 campos 3 and 4, Form 220 casillas 24 and 25.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.
fields.Query to RA:
DERIVED - the XML element name is not published in Res. 227; confirm against the DIAN technical specifications for Format 2276 v4.
Client to confirm the mapping of each master-data document column (Citizenship Card ID, Indentity Card for Foreigners, Identity Card, National ID) to the DIAN document-type code and the priority rule where more than one column is filled (14 of 261 rows), and to provide the identity of the 8 persons paid in the year who have no identification number in any mapped report. RA to confirm whose identity numeral 2 carries where the accumulators' 'Beneficiary National Id' differs from the employee or pensioner id.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Apellidos y nombres del beneficiario
fields.Format: A
fields.Field Explanation: COMPOSITE FIELD. The resolution names one numeral; the technical specification splits it into four columns - first surname, second surname, first given name, other given names - in the same order as every other DIAN artefact. Sub-field order matters: DIAN matches on the surname columns. SOURCE AT PMI: first surname = master-data Last Name; second surname = Second Last Name (blank allowed); first given name = First Name; other given names = Middle Name (blank allowed). Do NOT use the formatted full name. The four name parts must be retained for leavers and for employer-paid pensioners, who are not in the current master-data snapshot.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.
fields.Query to RA: DERIVED - the XML element name is not published in Res. 227; confirm against the DIAN technical specifications for Format 2276 v4.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Ubicacion del beneficiario
fields.Format: N (DIVIPOLA)
fields.Field Explanation: COMPOSITE FIELD - department (2 digits) and municipality (3 digits) of the beneficiary, on the DANE DIVIPOLA catalogue. Note that this is the BENEFICIARY's location, not the place of work reported in the electronic payroll (NIE051 / NIE052) nor the place where the withholding was practised reported in Form 220 (casillas 34 / 35). Three artefacts, three different geographic questions. SOURCE AT PMI: the client stores a letter department code and a free-text city, so the system must hold the beneficiary's DIVIPOLA department and municipality codes as master data (or convert through a maintained mapping table validated against DIVIPOLA); free text must never be sent. The value for a beneficiary whose address is outside Colombia must be confirmed against the Formato 2276 v4 technical specification (RA). Location must be retained for leavers and employer-paid pensioners.

DERIVED - the XML element name is not published in Res. 227; confirm against the DIAN technical specifications for Format 2276 v4.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos por salarios
fields.Format: N (whole pesos, no decimals, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Annual salary payments to the employee: ordinary and integral salary (100% of the integral salary - the 70% factor applies only to contribution bases), salary arrears, overtime and surcharges, and other remuneration that constitutes salary under CST art. 127 and is not reported in a more specific numeral. Fed by an explicit wage-type-to-numeral classification table, NOT by the payroll 'salary' indicator: at PMI that indicator also marks vacation pay and per diems, which belong to numerals 12 and 13. Each wage type feeds exactly one numeral. Accumulated on the PAYMENT date for 1 January to 31 December of the tax year; rolling or non-calendar accumulators must not be used. Maps to Form 220 casilla 36 and must equal it for the same employee and year.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated where the employee made voluntary pension-fund contributions. Distinct from numeral 25.
fields.Format: N (whole pesos, no decimals, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Voluntary contributions to voluntary pension funds under ET art. 126-1. Source: voluntary-pension deduction wage types carrying the configuration attribute 'voluntary pension fund (art. 126-1)'. At PMI the candidates are the '(FVOL)' provider wage types (25811-25815, 25823) and the institutional-plan wage types (25820, 25821, 21210, 21211, 65803, 65804); employer contributions to institutional plans and employee contributions must be told apart (65803 and 65804 are payment / bonus entries whose employer- or employee-side nature is not evidenced in the reports - client to confirm), and each wage type classified by the client before build. Maps to Form 220 casilla 56.

fields.Field Name (EN): Withholding on work or pension income
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Valor de las retenciones en la fuente por pagos de rentas de trabajo o pensiones
fields.Format: N (whole pesos, no decimals, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: THE PRINCIPAL WITHHOLDING NUMERAL: the income-tax withholding actually practised on the beneficiary's work or pension income in the tax year, by payment date. For a RESIDENT it is the ET art. 383 table result under Procedure 1 or 2; for a NON-RESIDENT it is the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on the gross. Source: every wage type that records withholding actually practised and remitted (at PMI the candidates are the employee income-tax wage type and the separate withholding wage types for terminations, retirees and equity awards; in the September withholding working report the 'with contribution' column equals the income-tax wage type for 255 of 261 employees and the 'Theoretical' withholding wage type for the other 6, 5 of them on integral salary). Notional, theoretical or hypothetical tax-equalisation amounts are included ONLY if they were actually withheld and declared on Form 350 - each wage type to be confirmed with the client and RA. Maps to Form 220 casilla 60, and the sum across the population reconciles to twelve months of Form 350 casilla 93.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, no decimals, no thousand separators; zero-filled when nil (Res. 227 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (EN): Monthly meal payments up to 41 UVT
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos por alimentacion mensuales hasta 41 UVT
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated where the employer made meal payments to a third party for an employee whose monthly salary does not exceed 310 UVT. Bidirectional pair with numeral 8 (the excess). Where the salary exceeds 310 UVT the whole payment falls to numeral 7 and BOTH this numeral and numeral 8 stay nil.
fields.Format: N (whole pesos, no decimals, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: INFORMATIVE ONLY. Res. 227 para. 1: the value of numeral 32 is informative and corresponds to ET art. 387-1. It does NOT enter the gross total in numeral 22. BIDIRECTIONAL PAIR WITH NUMERAL 8, which carries the excess above 41 UVT. Form 220 has NO counterpart casilla. Computed MONTH BY MONTH per employee: the meal payment to a third party up to 41 UVT (COP 2,147,334 in 2026), only in months where the employee's salary does not exceed 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 in 2026). Source: the meal-allowance-in-kind wage type(s) tagged as 'meal paid to a third party' (at PMI the candidate is 'Meal Allowance Inf.' - client to confirm it is paid to a food supplier).

fields.Field Name (EN): Average labour income of the last six months
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Valor ingreso laboral promedio de los ultimos seis meses. Unicamente para trabajadores que aplique el numeral 4 articulo 206 E.T.
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated ONLY for employees to whom ET art. 206 num. 4 applies - that is, where severance or its interest was paid or deposited. Bidirectional with numerals 18, 19 and 20: a record carrying any of those three should carry this average.
fields.Format: N (whole pesos, no decimals, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Rolling_6M_Average_Labour_Income [Calculated: rolling 6-month average -- no dedicated WTC code; see CO-DIAN-004 row 51]
fields.Field Explanation: The rolling six-month average that drives the ET art. 206 num. 4 severance exemption and its taper - full exemption where it does not exceed 350 UVT (COP 18,330,900 per month in 2026). The resolution restricts it expressly: 'UNICAMENTE para employees que aplique el numeral 4 art. 206 E.T.'. The engine must maintain the average YEAR-ROUND; it cannot be reconstructed from annual totals.
fields.Rounding: Whole pesos, no decimals, no thousand separators; zero-filled when nil (Res. 227 par. 2).
fields.Query to RA: DERIVED - the XML element name is not published in Res. 227; confirm against the DIAN technical specifications for Format 2276 v4.

fields.Field Name (EN): Economic dependant document type and identification number
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Tipo de documento y numero de identificacion del dependiente economico
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only where the employee claimed the ET art. 387 para. 2 dependants deduction during the year. Bidirectional with Form 220 casillas 79 to 82, which carry the same dependant with the addition of the name and relationship.
fields.Format: N (code) + AN (number)
fields.Field Explanation: COMPOSITE FIELD - document type and number of the economic dependant claimed under ET art. 387 para. 2. Sub-field 1 = document type code; sub-field 2 = the number. THIS IS THE FIELD DIAN USES TO CROSS-CHECK a dependant claimed by more than one taxpayer, which is why it must agree with Form 220 casillas 79 and 80 exactly.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.
fields.Query to RA: DERIVED - the XML element name is not published in Res. 227; confirm against the DIAN technical specifications for Format 2276 v4.

fields.Field Explanation: NIT of the reporting employer. Res. 227 art. 1.3.9.1.3 keys the DEADLINE to it: the LAST digit for a Gran Taxpayer, the LAST TWO digits for a legal or natural person.
